title: Boston Gas Company files a 365 Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with The Gillette Company.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department approves the Company's proposed Agreement and also grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure, the pricing terms to be purchased under the Agreement from public disclosure, pursuant to G.L. c. 25 & 5D. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasinton, and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
